FIND YOUR STATE
Save on Simply Piano with ESA funds
Simply Piano is now available for eligible families through ESA, in select states.
Simply Piano supports piano learning at home with a structured path, real-time feedback, and practice that fits around homeschool, charter school, tutoring, or family routines.
Find your state’s ESA instructions
ESA rules are different in every state. Find your state below to see what to check before using ESA funds for Simply Piano. We are currently available in Texas, Louisiana, Utah, Wyoming, South Carolina, Arizona, and Florida.
1
Log in to the Odyssey Marketplace.
2
Search for Simply Piano in the marketplace.
3
Choose a 3-month or annual subscription and place your order using your ESA funds.
4
After your order is approved, EduChoice USA will email your activation code.
5
Fill in your activation code on our Simply Redeem website to activate your subscription.

How to use ESA funds for Simply Piano
ESA families using Odyssey can purchase Simply Piano through the Odyssey Marketplace with their ESA funds. No invoice or out-of-pocket payment is required.

3

steps.title: Everyday moments of joy
steps.text:
Skip to main content
Skip to footer
GET STARTED
▶
Everyday moments of joy
Bring creativity and joy into your home
Your next creative hobby is closer than you think. Whether you've always wanted to play piano or guitar, express yourself through drawing, or find your singing voice, Simply’s courses are designed by educators and enhanced by AI to guide you through lessons you’ll love, help you build confidence, and make creativity a part of everyday life.
START YOUR JOURNEY
Let your journey begin
Pick up a new creative hobby or take one you already enjoy to the next level.
Have the time of your life learning
Make it a time for your creative expression or a way to connect with loved ones.
Find your own rhythm
Our advanced tech shapes itself around you, so every lesson feels like it was made just for you.
Whatever your level, gain the skills you need to play the songs you love and make your piano dreams come true.
MORE ON PIANO
Whether you’re a seasoned strummer or just starting your musical journey, Simply Guitar makes learning an absolute blast with personalized tutorials and feedback.
MORE ON GUITAR
Your AI singing companion personalizes every lesson to your voice, your range, your goals - so no note is out of reach.
MORE ON SING
Dive into the captivating world of pencil drawing with our step-by-step instructions and personalized courses.
MORE ON DRAW
Keep your guitar, bass, or ukelele in perfect pitch with our fast, easy, and 100% free tuner.
